name: 脆甜多汁奶白果肉冬枣款
description: 绿底金环国风版式，脆甜多汁、核小肉厚、奶白果肉的新鲜冬枣套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep pine green #145C45 poster panels alternating with warm cream white #F7F2E7 sections and gold thin-line framed photo cards
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft natural daylight around 5500K, gentle soft top light, soft contact shadows, fresh dewy mood, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: natural bamboo woven trays, light wood boards and straw woven mats
styleLock.typography: modern serif headlines only, one family
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line gold arc frames, cloud-line motifs and dashed-circle motifs, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable fruit scale and natural glossy rendering across the set, loose piles and cut halves read as the same fruit, every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh oriental produce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine green #145C45 panels, warm cream white #F7F2E7 sections, white #FFFFFF text on dark panels, deep green #145C45 text on light panels, and one warm gold accent #C9A063; warm natural daylight around 5500K with soft top light and soft contact shadows, fresh dewy mood; modern serif headlines only, one family; consistent thin-line gold arc frames, cloud-line motifs and dashed-circle motifs; natural bamboo, light wood and straw surfaces with clean food photography mixed with minimal infographic cards; stable fruit scale, glossy natural skin, never plastic; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking fruit.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，国风绿底金字抢眼开屏
shots.camera: eye-level front view with a slight upward tilt, full pile visible, one loose fruit floating upper-left
shots.lighting: soft top daylight, gentle highlight on fruit skin, soft contact shadow under the pile
shots.background: deep pine green #145C45 gradient poster panel with one thin-line gold #C9A063 arc frame
shots.props: a round bamboo woven tray holding the pile; two blurred fern leaves in the top corners
shots.textZone: right third vertical headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF with one small gold-framed seal-style label 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: Vertical e-commerce poster hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at an eye-level front view with a slight upward tilt: a generous loose pile of the fruit in a round bamboo woven tray fills the lower two thirds, 65-75% of the frame, one loose fruit floating at the upper left with a soft drop shadow. Soft top daylight, gentle highlights on the glossy natural skin, soft contact shadow grounding the pile. Background a deep pine green #145C45 gradient poster panel with one thin-line gold #C9A063 arc frame and two blurred fern leaves in the top corners. The right third completes the composition with a vertical headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one small gold-framed seal-style label 「{callout_1}」 beneath it. 8K commercial produce quality. Negative: no brand names, no QR codes, no watermarks, no fake logos, no English slogan text, no plastic-looking fruit, no cut-off fruit edges, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 用微距切面证明果肉奶白细脆、核小肉厚

shots.lighting: soft raking side light from the right revealing crisp flesh texture, gentle top fill, controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, the cut face is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the cut face of one halved fruit. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree angle, shallow depth of field with the cut face sharp, showing its pale crisp flesh texture and a small slender pit. Soft raking side light from the right revealing the fine crisp texture, gentle top fill, controlled highlight on the skin. Blurred light wood board #C89B6A background. The cut face fills 55-60% of the frame, margins minimal because the cut face is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking flesh, no invented nutrition claims, no text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated fruit elements.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张冬枣爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字、会员二维码、原文案与不可验证声明（有机/无农药/0添加/顺丰包邮等一律改为可替换的 {callout} 文案槽），产品一律以 {product} 占位；资质与检测数据不在图中虚构，由使用方按实际资质补充。
